verdicts.reason: A keeps the framed label and the illustration row, but the rule lines under LAVANDER are offset to the right and no longer frame the wordmark, a stray rule floats beside the jars, the bottles are cropped by the bottom edge, and the text is small and crowded at the left of the label. B is broken: the white label frame sits empty with only a stray rule in it, all the text is pushed onto the bare background on the right with a jumbled order (headline, then HOMEMADE LOTION, then J'adore Paris), a blurry oversized butterfly and a macaron float at random, and the illustrations are shrunk to a tiny strip.
